method: Enumerated every linked model and fetched the info/animations/effects/parts JSON used by EnemyViewer.CYQ2z2Fd.js; joined local EnemyData model_id and animation_model_id to attack definitions. Reyburn uses its dedicated boss kit. Attack-named unused clips are review candidates, not proven missing attacks. Generic atk may resolve through aliases/alphabetical fallback. No frame-by-frame visual validation of all clips was performed.

attacks.note: runs toward the player (wlk2) and bites (atkh2 heavy bite)
wing flap blows the player away along the facing and deals damage
war cry with a blast radius in a circle around the dragon
fires three fireballs while standing — one per brslp rep; brs1 (0.5s) likely the single-shot variant
flies away, then deals damage in a circle where it lands
from the air: a fireball at the ground that splits into 3 parts
